stories.title: Kevin Durant's Tribute to Russell Westbrook — KD Reconciliation + Jersey Retirement Push

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Kevin Durant's tribute to Russell Westbrook hit different.

KD called the career "iconic" and said Russ was "quiet and methodical."

Now Jalen Williams is pushing for Opening Night jersey retirement. The No. 0 belongs in the OKC rafters. #OKCThunder

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Jalen Williams said "dare I say opening night" when asked about retiring Westbrook's No. 0.

Thunder home opener: Oct. 22.

If OKC does it, Westbrook joins Nick Collison as just the second jersey retired in franchise history. The legacy is growing fast. #OKCThunder

research.facts:
Kevin Durant Tribute to Russell Westbrook
**Facts verified (HIGH confidence):**
- KD posted tribute on social media Aug 13-14 calling career "iconic"; described Westbrook as "quiet and methodical" despite outward emotions on court; acknowledged complicated relationship directly [Bleacher Report, Heavy]
- Retirement video produced with Academy Award-winning actor Michael B. Jordan [Revolt.tv]
- Jalen Williams posted "dare I say opening night...🤓" in response to fan suggestion of immediate jersey retirement [Heavy, Thunderous Intentions]
- Thunder home opener is October 22 [schedule released Aug 13]
- Westbrook's No. 0 would be only the second jersey retired in OKC franchise history (joining Nick Collison) [SI]
- Other tributes: Donovan Mitchell, Trae Young, Kendrick Perkins (recalled Scott Brooks quote about Westbrook giving team "swag") [FOX Sports]
- Career totals: 209 triple-doubles all-time record, 18 seasons, nine-time All-Star, 2017 MVP [multiple sources]
**Facts verified (MEDIUM confidence):**
- KD tribute generated secondary reaction wave from CJ McCollum and other players [Bleacher Report, Heavy — consistent but secondary sourcing]

research.facts:
Kawhi Leonard Investigation
**Facts verified (HIGH confidence):**
- Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz completed fact-finding; NBA currently reviewing [HoopsHype, ESPN]
- Investigation is 11 months old [HoopsHype]
- Trade: Leonard to Toronto for Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick, unprotected 2031+2033 first-round picks [multiple sources]
- Kawhi owed $50.3M in 2026-27 [multiple sources]
- Current CBA does not list player suspension as punishment for cap circumvention [SI/All Clippers]
- Leonard personally is largely insulated; Clippers face sanctions [HoopsHype, ESPN]
**Facts verified (MEDIUM confidence):**
- Resolution expected within 6 weeks (~Sept. 22) per league circles [HoopsHype — single sourcing on internal belief]
- Leonard expects trade to Toronto to be completed [RealGM]
- Quebec City training camp Sept. 28-29 window [HoopsHype]
**Tension to flag:** ESPN and HoopsHype both have July 29 reporting that investigation could extend into 2027 if complications arise. The 6-week estimate is league circles, not the NBA office.

research.facts:
Wembanyama / France FIBA
**Facts verified (HIGH confidence):**
- France 15-player FIBA roster: Victor Wembanyama, Rudy Gobert, Evan Fournier confirmed [FIBA official, Eurohoops]
- Schedule: Aug. 20 exhibition vs. Serbia (Belgrade), Aug. 23 exhibition (Orleans), Aug. 27 qualifier vs. Slovenia (home), Aug. 30 qualifier in Sweden [FIBA official]
- France atop Group L at 5-1 entering second round [Eurohoops]
- First FIBA appearance for Wemby since 2024 Paris Olympics silver medal; skipped EuroBasket 2025 [France 24, Eurohoops]
- New French national team coach: Frederic Fauthoux [Eurohoops]
- Wemby is 22 years old, NBA All-Star, Defensive Player of the Year [multiple sources]
- Quote: "I don't miss the NBA at the moment, but I do miss FIBA." [Eurohoops, France 24]

research.facts:
Stephen Curry Extension
**Facts verified (HIGH confidence):**
- Window opens Aug. 29 — 14 days away [confirmed across multiple sources]
- Extension value: 2 years, $136.7M [Yahoo Sports, Bleacher Report]
- Curry is 38 years old, in final year of current deal [Yahoo Sports]
- Mutual interest confirmed by ESPN's Anthony Slater [Bleacher Report]
- Warriors posture: full offer, whatever Curry decides [Bleacher Report, Yahoo Sports]
- GM Mike Dunleavy Jr. aligned with Curry's wishes [Yahoo Sports]
- Brian Windhorst argued Warriors should NOT rush signing — $65-70M/yr limits flexibility [NBC Sports Bay Area, Yahoo Sports]
- Draymond Green back on 1yr/$27.7M [multiple sources]
**Facts verified (MEDIUM confidence):**
- Curry expected to sign per multiple reports [Bleacher Report, Yahoo Sports — not confirmed by Curry directly]
